scripts.title: Unbreakable Soul: The Shopkeeper's Stand
scripts.logline: When a mob shatters a vintage anime sanctuary, an ordinary shopkeeper and brave youths channel real Shonen spirit to defend their home.
scripts.logline_de: Als ein Mob einen Retro-Anime-Laden verwüstet, erheben sich ein einfacher Ladenbesitzer und mutige Jugendliche mit wahrem Shonen-Geist, um ihr Heiligtum zu verteidigen.

setting.location: Fictional Neo-District shopping alley, stylized retro city
setting.color_palette: Deep amber sunset lights, neon cyan highlights, high-contrast dark shadows, vibrant anime energy gold
setting.art_style: 1990s retro anime screencap, hand-drawn cel shading, strong line work, heavy film grain, subtle VHS chromatic aberration, dynamic light beams

shots.camera: Low angle, static wide shot with rapid camera shake
shots.action: A shop front window shatters in slow motion, glass shards showering onto the asphalt like glowing diamonds.
sfx: Glass exploding sound with deep heavy bass echo
shots.music: Fast dramatic orchestral strings and synth rock riff
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, hand-drawn film grain. Low angle shot of a vintage anime shop window shattering outward in mid-air, sparkling glass shards flying towards camera, dark urban shopping street bathed in twilight orange lighting, intense dramatic cinematic shot.
shots.motion_prompt: Impact burst effect, glass particles fly forward with speed lines, dynamic camera shake on glass break.

shots.camera: Medium shot, Dutch angle, slow zoom in
shots.action: Ren stands at the threshold of his shattered store entrance, dust rising around his feet, eyes narrowed in stern defiance.

dialogue.line: I won't let you destroy this sanctuary!

shots.music: Pulsing Shonen battle beat building up
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Ren, 32yo male anime shopkeeper, messy spiky teal-blue hair, sharp jawline, wearing an oversized dark slate-grey hoodie, standing firm in a broken shop door surrounded by glass debris, shadow across his forehead, heroic Dutch angle perspective.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera push-in, wind blowing hoodie strings and teal hair, smoke particles wafting up.

shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder wide shot, fast whip pan
shots.action: Shadowy rioters surge forward. Vane dashes out from the side, aiming a sneaky blow from behind towards Ren.

dialogue.line: Out of the way, old man!

shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Action wide shot, Vane with crimson cybernetic goggles and dark purple hair lunges forward in a dynamic dash position targeting Ren from behind, high contrast shadows, anime speed lines in background.
shots.motion_prompt: Whip pan tracking Vane's fast sprint motion, heavy impact speed lines flashing.

shots.camera: Close-up impact shot with inverted color flash frame
shots.action: Vane hits Ren's back! An inverted black-and-white impact frame flashes as shockwaves ripple through Ren's hoodie.
sfx: Heavy hit physical impact punch sound
shots.music: Sudden stop of music to single ringing synth tone
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, impact frame style. Close-up on Ren getting struck in the back, black and white inverted high-contrast frame, stylized force shockwave radiating outward, dramatic expression of strain.
shots.motion_prompt: Inverted black-and-white flash frame for 2 frames, screen tremor and dynamic radial lines.

shots.camera: Medium low shot, tracking downward movement
shots.action: Ren staggers forward onto one knee, catching himself on the glass-strewn floor. A tiny bead of blood appears at the corner of his lip.
shots.voiceover: I can't fall... not here... not today!
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Ren kneeling on broken glass floor, dark slate-grey hoodie, teal hair shadow covering upper face, single drop of blood on lip, hand clenched on pavement surrounded by sharp glass reflections.
shots.motion_prompt: Ren drops to one knee with dust cloud burst, slow camera tilt down following motion.

shots.action: Vane points menacingly at the store interior, surrounded by dark shadow silhouettes of advancing rioters.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Low angle close-up of Vane shouting behind red face-mask, crimson goggles shining under neon lights, shadowy mob silhouettes in background, sinister dramatic lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Vane thrusts arm forward aggressively, shadows in background surge motion.

shots.camera: Dynamic side tracking shot, rapid movement
shots.action: Yuna leaps into the doorway frame, landing between the hostile mob and Ren, arms wide open in defiance.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Yuna, 19yo female anime heroine with bright magenta twin pigtails, wearing yellow-and-black retro windbreaker, landing heroically with arms spread out wide in front of shop door.
shots.motion_prompt: Fast slide-in animation, camera locks onto Yuna as wind coat flares.

shots.camera: Tight face shot, reverse reaction shot
shots.action: Yuna stares down Vane with fierce eyes, shouting with all her voice.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Close-up on Yuna's fierce face, violet eyes wide with anger and determination, magenta pigtails flying in wind, vibrant high contrast background lighting.
shots.motion_prompt: Hair fluttering in wind, camera slight tremble on vocal burst.

shots.action: Ren's eye snaps open! Golden energy sparks flame inside his dark brown iris as ambient sound drops to total silence.
shots.music: Complete mute silence except for rising synth aura tone
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, extreme close-up shot on Ren's eyes opening wide, dark brown iris bursting with golden anime energy sparks, intense dramatic line shadows across brow.
shots.motion_prompt: Pupil contracts, eye glints with animated golden electrical spark arcs.

shots.camera: Full shot, ground-level camera looking up
shots.action: Ren rises to his feet as a blazing golden Super Saiyan-style aura erupts around his body, sending small glass pieces floating into the air.
shots.music: Full 90s Shonen power-up electric guitar explosion
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Ren standing up fully illuminated by a fiery translucent golden energy aura surround, teal hair standing up from aura heat, small glass shards floating upward around him, epic power-up scene.
shots.motion_prompt: Flames of golden aura flickering upward violently, glass shards floating up slowly.

shots.action: Ren slams his foot down; a massive shockwave burst unleashes from his aura, pushing back Vane and the rioters.
sfx: Sonic blast energy blow wave sound
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, film grain. Wide battle scene, brilliant golden energy shockwave expanding outward in ring form, blowing rioters back, speed lines radiating from Ren standing in center.
shots.motion_prompt: Radial shockwave ring expands fast, screen shaking, opponents blown back.

shots.camera: Medium shot with background art spotlight
shots.action: Behind Ren in the damaged frame, a large vintage warrior poster glows in sync with his golden energy aura, symbolizing unity.
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading. Ren standing resolute in center frame, right next to a life-size anime hero poster cutout glowing with matching golden light inside shattered storefront, epic framing.
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle camera drift, light beams radiating from poster cutout and Ren.

shots.camera: Medium wide shot, low camera angle, static
shots.action: The rioters scatter down the alley. Dust settles. Ren stands shoulder-to-shoulder with Yuna in front of the shop.

dialogue.line: Thank you... for standing with me.

shots.music: Warm emotional synth pad resolving theme
shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, heavy film grain. Ren and Yuna standing side-by-side in ruined shop entryway, sunset twilight glowing behind them, smoke fading away, peaceful heroic posture.
shots.motion_prompt: Smoke drift slows, gentle wind animation in clothes, sunset light softening.

shots.camera: Close-up portrait shot, slow zoom out
shots.action: Ren looks straight ahead with a calm, indestructible smile. Golden embers fade gently into the twilight air.

dialogue.line: As long as we stand together, dreams never die.

shots.image_prompt: 1990s retro anime screencap, cel shading, warm lighting. Close-up on Ren looking at viewer with calm confident smile, light golden sparks lingering in air, warm sunset tones.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow camera zoom out, golden sparks floating down gently.

shots.action: Black screen with crisp white title text and legal disclaimer displayed.

source.event: Vor einem Ladenlokal in einer Einkaufsstraße liegen Scherben und Gegenstände auf dem Boden. Ein Mann verteidigt den beschädigten Eingangsbereich eines Geschäfts, wird dabei von Passanten konfrontiert und körperlich angegriffen. Umstehende greifen deeskalierend ein und rufen zum Aufhören auf, woraufhin der Mann sichtbar mitgenommen im zerstörten Schaufensterrahmen stehen bleibt.
